contract.fallback: Unallocated capital remains in US-INDEX-BASKET close-to-close.
contract.signalTiming: Forecast issue-date signals are used only on trading sessions strictly after the issue date.
contract.reversionTiming: Reversion legs use realized UNG move through the weather leg and start no earlier than the next trading session.
contract.selectionPolicy: Rank and eligibility use train and validation splits only; holdout metrics are reported after selection.

selected.architectureDescription: Use the weather signal only to identify fear windows, then wait and fade the realized UNG move.
